text:
ana: quick design review: compact version-history on the rollout page is hard to scan when multiple rollouts happen within an hour. timestamps read '2m ago' stacked and the chevrons are tiny.

leo: saw that. on narrow widths the rows collapse and the version label truncates to 'v12' which loses the meaningful commit message.

rachel: right — support asked to show more context in audit logs. maybe surface a short commit excerpt or the author initials next to the version.

olga: accessibility note: screen reader currently only announces 'version twelve' and not the change summary or time. we should include aria-describedby linking to the summary and use dateFormat that SR reads cleanly (e.g., '2 minutes ago, March 3rd at 14:05').

ana: (typo meant ana) UX thought: change the tiny chevron to a larger 24px hit target and make the whole row focusable. inside the row, use arrow keys to move between actions (diff, revert, expand).

leo: copy question: the revert action label is 'Rollback' in current designs. Ops suggested 'Revert to this version' because 'Rollback' feels vague. Which is clearer?

rachel: prefer explicit: 'Revert to this version' as primary label in the confirm modal. Keep the compact action button labeled 'Revert' to save space. Add a secondary line in the modal: 'This will replace the current deployment with version v12.'

olga: SR string proposal: when user triggers revert, announce 'Revert initiated: replacing current deployment with version v12. Confirm by pressing Enter.' Make sure the modal gets focus and aria-modal=true.

ana: dev note: the diff peek overlay currently steals focus and is not closable with Escape reliably. fix to handle Escape, and make the overlay role='dialog' with aria-label='Version diff'.

leo: visual density: can we collapse consecutive versions by the same author into a grouped compact node on the timeline? maybe show a stacked mini-avatar and a '+3' badge. Might reduce noise.

rachel: good idea but audit logs need the full list. hovering the collapsed node should show a terse list with timestamps. ensure the hover tooltip uses a delay (400ms) to avoid accidental popups when moving the mouse.

olga: for SR, the collapsed node should still be keyboard-expandable and when expanded, use aria-live='polite' to announce 'expanded 4 versions by Taylor, newest at 2 minutes ago'.

design-bot: ACTIONS: ana to mock larger hit target + row focusable pattern; rachel to draft modal copy + microcopy for compact buttons; olga to produce SR strings and aria mappings; leo to prototype grouped-version node and tooltip timing. Due: Wed EOD. 

ana: will do two mocks: one that shows author initials + commit excerpt inline, another that shows stacked avatars with +N badge. I'll include CSS tokens and suggested hit target values.

leo: one more tiny nit: the timeline 'time-since' label uses relative time which becomes confusing when you view older history. Add an expandable exact timestamp on click (e.g., tooltip showing '2026-03-03 14:05 UTC').

olga: yes, include a 'readable' date format string for SR: 'March third, twenty twenty-six at two oh five PM UTC'.

rachel: perfect. I'll also add a FAQ blurb in the audit log docs explaining 'Revert vs Promote vs Canary' phrasing.

ana: thanks all. i'll post mocks tomorrow morning and tag eng. :sparkles:
